kai: Repro note: sample-app streaming resume occasionally emits leading NULs (0x00) or delivers event fragments out-of-order after reconnect. Happens only behind local dev proxy.
nina: which SDK/version? browser or node?
kai: browser SDK (latest), using fetch polyfill. flow: abort -> reconnect with Last-Event-ID. ~5% of reconnects show messy bytes at start, other times chunks come back shuffled. Logs: ```[recv] 0x00 0x00 0x1f 0x64 0x61 0x74 0x61 ...\n[recv] data: {"seq":3,"text":"ok"}\n[recv] data: {"seq":2,"text":"hi"}\n[parser] Combined => '{"seq":3,"text":"ok"}{"seq":2,"text":"hi"}' -> parse error```
jon: sounds like proxy is reusing buffers or multiplexing backend writes. Does direct-to-backend repro?
kai: direct -> no. curl --no-buffer -> clean. Only shows up via dev proxy (mitm).
nina: can you attach the minimal repro in sample-app? we should add a test that forces token refresh during reconnect, sometimes the auth refresh triggers small POSTs that might interleave.
kai: added sample-app/streaming/repro steps and a tiny node server that intentionally interleaves writes. snippet: ```res.write('data: {"seq":3,"text":"ok"}\n\n'); setTimeout(()=>res.write('data: {"seq":2,"text":"hi"}\n\n'), 1);```
infra-bot: Filed INF-902: "dev proxy: investigate buffer reuse / interleaved writes on warm connections".
nina: short-term SDK fix: buffer incoming bytes and only split events on full SSE delimiter ("\n\n"). Also defensively trim leading control bytes (<= 0x1f) before parsing an event and log a metric when trimming.
jon: agree. Also add optional seq handling: if events include a seq field, keep a small reorder buffer (max N=16) and reorder/hold until missing seq arrives or timeout. That covers partial reorder without breaking normal flow.
kai: implemented a local hack: strip leading non-printables and buffer until double newline; seems stable in my local runs. Will open PR behind feature flag.
devex-bot: Created DEX-1199 "streaming: defensive parser + seq reorder buffer; investigate dev-proxy buffer reuse".
jon: infra please capture a pcap on next repro (tcpdump) and try toggling keepalive/pooling in proxy to confirm.
infra-bot: INF-902 updated with request for pcap and keepalive-off experiment on test host.
nina: small note for tests: ensure comments and retry fields are preserved when buffering. also add unit tests for trimmed-leading-bytes case.
kai: will add tests and attach pcap once infra provides. thanks all :+1:
